# `aitbc tee status`

Check the status of a TEE enclave.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc tee status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--enclave-id` | text | — | yes | The Enclave-id. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc tee status --enclave-id <enclave_id>
```
